subject.title: Add an FxTwitter read transport for public lookups, threads, profiles, and search

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for deferred FxTwitter threads, profiles, timelines, and search, or is the merged single-tweet MVP the complete intended product scope?
rationale: The owner approved and shipped only a narrow subset while explicitly deferring substantial requested behavior, so automation cannot infer whether deferred means future work or intentionally out of scope.

options.title: Track one next surface
options.body: Keep this issue open but narrow it to the next sponsored public-read capability, preserving fixed-origin and explicit-opt-in safety.

options.title: Close at MVP
options.body: Declare the merged single-tweet importer the complete accepted scope and close the broader deferred requests as unsponsored.

options.title: Split follow-ups
options.body: Create separate canonical issues for sponsored thread, profile, or search work, then close this umbrella issue.

recommendation.title: Track one next surface
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open but narrow it to the next sponsored public-read capability, preserving fixed-origin and explicit-opt-in safety.

likelyOwner.reason: He defined the accepted MVP, authored its implementation, and is the only evidence-backed owner of the remaining product boundary.
